Plug TS24-U adapter into electrical outlet. 通过适配器、太阳能电池板和电池连接。 1. 将TCS3太阳能充电控制器的BAT线连接到控制板的“+BAT-”端子。 2. 缠绕TCS3太阳能控制器的LOAD线，以防止短路。 3. 串联连接两个12VDC电池，以获得24VDC电源（不包括电池）。 4. 将电池连接到控制板的“+BAT-”端子。 5. Power Mode 3 By the Adapter, Solar Panels and Batteries 1. Connect the BAT wires of the TCS3 solar charge controller to the “+BAT-” terminals of the c
content_zh:
通过适配器、太阳能电池板和电池连接。
1. 将TCS3太阳能充电控制器的BAT线连接到控制板的“+BAT-”端子。
2. 缠绕TCS3太阳能控制器的LOAD线，以防止短路。
3. 串联连接两个12VDC电池，以获得24VDC电源（不包括电池）。
4. 将电池连接到控制板的“+BAT-”端子。
5. 组装太阳能电池板，并将太阳能电池板并联连接，安装在没有障碍物和遮挡物（如建筑物和树木）的区域。如果位于赤道以北，太阳能电池板应朝南；如果位于赤道以南，则应朝北。
6. 将TCS3太阳能控制器的SOLAR线连接到太阳能电池板。
7. 将TS24-U适配器连接到控制板的“ADAPTER”端子，不考虑线的极性。
8. 将TS24-U适配器插入电源插座。
content_en:
Power Mode 3 By the Adapter, Solar Panels and Batteries
1. Connect the BAT wires of the TCS3 solar charge controller to the “+BAT-” terminals of the control board.
2. Tape the LOAD wires of the TCS3 solar controller to prevent a short circuit.
3. Connect two 12VDC batteries in series to achieve 24VDC (batteries not included).
4. Connect the batteries to the “+BAT-” terminals of the control board.
5. Assemble the solar panels and connect the solar panels in parallel and mount in an area clear of all obstructions and shading from buildings and trees. The solar panel should face south if it is located north of the equator. If it is located south of the equator, it should face north.
6. Connect the SOLAR wires of the TCS3 solar controller to the solar panels.
7. Connect the TS24-U adapter to the "ADAPTER" terminals of the control board, regardless of the polarity of the wires.
8. Plug the TS24-U adapter into an electrical outlet.

The TCS3 Solar Charge Controller supports a maximum solar panel po
content_zh:
电池应防水，或应放置在防水外壳中。
TCS3太阳能充电控制器支持的最大太阳能电池板功率为240W，超过此限制可能会造成损坏。
如果系统仅由电池供电并利用太阳能电池板充电，则至少需要一个24VDC 12Ah汽车/船用电池和一个24V 20W太阳能电池板。
如果每天有超过6小时的日照，并且没有连接附件（光电传感器、电锁、按钮和警示灯除外），开门机每天可运行10次循环。
如果每天日照少于6小时，或者使用任何附件（例如外部接收器、出门按钮或有线键盘），请添加更多太阳能电池板并增加电池容量。
有关太阳能电池板功率和电池容量的精确建议，请通过www.topens.com联系我们的客户支持。
content_en:
The batteries should be waterproof, or they should be placed in waterproof housing.
The TCS3 Solar Charge Controller supports a maximum solar panel power of 240W, exceeding this limit can cause damage to it.
If the system is only powered by battery and utilizes the solar panel for charging, a minimum of a 24VDC 12Ah automotive/marine type battery and a 24V 20W solar panel are required.
If there are more than 6 hours of sunlight per day and no accessories are connected (except for the photocell sensor, electric lock, push button, and warning light), the gate opener can operate 10 cycles per day.
Add more solar panels and increase battery capacity if there is less than 6 hours of sunlight per day or if using any accessories (such as an external receiver, exit wand, or wired keypad).
For precise recommendations on solar panel power and battery capacity, please contact our customer support at www.topens.com.

content_zh:
注意关于电池和太阳能电池板：
电池应防水，或放置在防水外壳中。
UPS01 电源支持最大 240W 的太阳能电池板功率，超过此限制可能会损坏 UPS01 电源。

The batteries should be waterproof, or they should be placed in waterproof housing.

If AC power failures occur for less than 8 hours per day, you can use a minimum of 24VDC 5Ah automotive/marine type battery and a 24V 10W solar panel as a backup power source.

question: Function of the Remote Control Button
embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Program the Remote Control Function of the Remote Control Button Title:Function of the Remote Control Button Program the Remote Control - Function of the Remote Control Button: A, B, C, D buttons, shared function for swing gate, button press cycles gate (open, stop, close). ◆ 每个遥控器有四个按钮，从上到下分别是 A、B、C 和 D。 ◆ 对于平移门开门机，所有四个按钮共享相同的功能。您可以使用其中任何一个按钮与开门机进行编程。 ◆ 每次按下已编程按钮将使大门循环开启、停止、关闭、停止和开启。 ◆ Each remote has four buttons, from top to bottom are separately A, B, C and D. ◆ For the swing gate opener, all four buttons share the same function
content_zh:
◆ 每个遥控器有四个按钮，从上到下分别是 A、B、C 和 D。
◆ 对于平移门开门机，所有四个按钮共享相同的功能。您可以使用其中任何一个按钮与开门机进行编程。
◆ 每次按下已编程按钮将使大门循环开启、停止、关闭、停止和开启。
content_en:
◆ Each remote has four buttons, from top to bottom are separately A, B, C and D.
◆ For the swing gate opener, all four buttons share the same function. You can use any of these buttons to program with the gate opener.
◆ Each press of the programmed button will cycle the gate through open, stop, close, stop, and open.

section: Adjust the Limit Switch · 1 For Pull-to-Open Installation: Adjust the Limit Switch B to Determine the Closed Position
question: For Pull-to-Open Installation: Adjust the Limit Switch B to Determine the Closed Position
embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Adjust the Limit Switch 1 For Pull-to-Open Installation: Adjust the Limit Switch B to Determine the Closed Position Title:For Pull-to-Open Installation: Adjust the Limit Switch B to Determine the Closed Position Pull-to-Open 拉式开门 拉开门 内开 inward opening 非推开门 Adjust the Limit Switch Pull-to-Open Installation Limit Switch B Closed Position adjustment moving rod fully retracted gate opener remote control inwards outwards 确保在调整限位开关之前，当门处于完全打开位置时，移动杆完全缩回。 通电操作开门器，臂杆将伸出以关闭门。 如果门关闭超过所需的关闭位置，请按遥控器停止开门器。使用螺丝刀松开限位开关B的螺丝，稍微向内滑动限位开关B。 如果门关闭到一半而未能达到所需的关闭位置，请稍微向外滑动限位开关B。 请重复上述步骤，直到门到达并自动停止在所需的关闭位置。然后拧紧螺丝。
content_zh:
确保在调整限位开关之前，当门处于完全打开位置时，移动杆完全缩回。
通电操作开门器，臂杆将伸出以关闭门。
如果门关闭超过所需的关闭位置，请按遥控器停止开门器。使用螺丝刀松开限位开关B的螺丝，稍微向内滑动限位开关B。
如果门关闭到一半而未能达到所需的关闭位置，请稍微向外滑动限位开关B。
请重复上述步骤，直到门到达并自动停止在所需的关闭位置。然后拧紧螺丝。
content_en:
Make sure that the moving rod is fully retracted when the gate is in the fully open position before adjusting the limit switch.
Turn on power to operate the gate opener, the arm will extend to close the gate.
If the gate closes over the desired closed position, press the remote control to stop the gate opener. Use a screwdriver to loosen the screw of the limit B, slightly slide the limit switch B inwards.
If the gate closes halfway and fails to get to the desired closed position, slightly slide the limit switch B outwards.
Please repeat the above steps until the gate reaches and automatically stops at the desired closed position. Then tighten the screw firmly.

section: Setting of the Control Board
question: Setting of the Control Board
content_zh:
电位器
FORCE 电位器：调整开门机的失速力
顺时针转动电位器可增加力，逆时针转动可减小力。
失速力调节门在操作过程中对障碍物的敏感性。较高的失速力会降低敏感性，使门更不容易检测到物体。较低的失速力会增加敏感性，导致门在遇到即使是轻微的障碍物时也会停止或反转。
AUTO CLOSE 电位器：调整开门机的自动关门时间
顺时针转动电位器可增加自动关门时间，逆时针转动可减小自动关门时间。自动关门时间可在 3 到 120 秒之间调整。
SOFT STOP 电位器：调整开门机的软停止周期
顺时针转动电位器可增加软停止周期，逆时针转动可减小软停止周期。软停止周期可在 1 到 5 秒之间调整。
软停止旨在门完全停止前的最后阶段减慢门速，从而保护电机。
在进行调整之前，请关闭开门机的电源。调整后，打开电源并使用遥控器运行完整的开门和关门循环以校准完整的开门和关门时间。这将确保调整在随后的循环中有效。
content_en:
Potentiometers
FORCE Potentiometer: Adjust the Stall Force of the Gate Opener
Turn the potentiometer clockwise to increase the force, and counterclockwise to decrease it.
Stall force regulates the gate's sensitivity to obstacles during operation. A higher stall force decreases sensitivity, making the gate less likely to detect objects. A lower stall force increases sensitivity, causing the gate to stop or reverse when encountering even minor obstructions.
AUTO CLOSE Potentiometer: Adjust the Auto Close Time of the Gate Opener
Turn the potentiometer clockwise to increase the auto close time, and counterclockwise to decrease it. The auto close time can be adjusted from 3 to 120 seconds.
SOFT STOP Potentiometer: Adjust the Soft Stop Period of the Gate Opener
Turn the potentiometer clockwise to increase the soft stop period, and counterclockwise to decrease it. The soft stop period can be adjusted from 1 to 5 seconds.
The soft stop is designed to slow down the gate during the final phase before it fully stops, protecting the motor.
Turn off the power to the gate opener before making adjustment. After adjusting, turn on the power and use the remote control to run a complete open and close cycle to calibrate the full open and close times. This will ensure the adjustment is effective in subsequent cycles.

images.caption: Potentiometers on the control board: FORCE, AUTO CLOSE, SOFT STOP

content_zh:
顺时针转动电位器可增加软停止周期，逆时针转动可减小软停止周期。软停止周期可在 1 到 5 秒之间调整。
软停止旨在门完全停止前的最后阶段减慢门速，从而保护电机。

content_en:
Turn the potentiometer clockwise to increase the soft stop period, and counterclockwise to decrease it. The soft stop period can be adjusted from 1 to 5 seconds.
The soft stop is designed to slow down the gate during the final phase before it fully stops, protecting the motor.
Turn off the power to the gate opener before making adjustment. After adjusting, turn on the power and use the remote control to run a complete open and close cycle to calibrate the full open and close times. This will ensure the adjustment is effective in subsequent cycles.

embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Stall Force Adjustment & Obstruction Test NOTES Title:NOTES Stall Force Adjustment & Obstruction Test: NOTES: Stall force sensitivity, obstruction test frequency, gate reversal, photocell sensor recommendation. If the stall force is set too low (i.e., the sensitivity is too high), the gate may stop or reverse too easily, even with minimal obstruction or resis
content_en:
If the stall force is set too low (i.e., the sensitivity is too high), the gate may stop or reverse too easily, even with minimal obstruction or resistance, such as strong wind or heavy snow.
Always perform an obstruction test for the gate each time you set up the control board or restart it after a power outage.
The gate opener is designed to reverse the gate when the gate comes in contact with an obstruction during closing and to stop the gate during opening. It is highly recommended to install a photocell sensor for additional safety.

section: Important Safety Information & Note For Warranty
question: Important Safety Information & Note For Warranty
content_zh:
重要安全信息

检查门体的整个摆动路径。定期检查您的立柱，根据需要调整支架或拧紧硬件。在进行任何维护之前，请关闭开门器的电源。

障碍物保护测试：每月测试门机。当门接触到刚性物体或当物体激活非接触式传感器时，门必须反向或停止。调整力和行程限制后，重新测试门机。未能正确调整和重新测试门机可能会增加受伤或死亡的风险。

电源断开和手动开门：了解如何断开电源并手动开门。仅当门不在运动中且门机系统关闭时，才能将门机与门断开。

识别自动化门系统中的潜在风险：保存安装手册。确保每个使用或将要靠近门和门机的人都了解自动化门系统的危险。如果需要更换手册，可以从TOPENS网站（www.topens.com）下载一份副本。

保修注意事项

保修范围限于目标市场：保修范围限于目标市场（美国本土、加拿大、英国和德国）。在这些地区以外使用产品的客户，在保修更换过程中需要承担任何额外费用。

开门器滥用：TOPENS不承担因滥用造成的损坏，例如试图在超出其规定容量或用于非预期目的的情况下操作开门器。

开门器误用：TOPENS不承担因误用造成的损坏，包括但不限于使用不兼容电源操作开门器或在TOPENS不推荐的环境中使用。

改动或修改：未经TOPENS事先咨询对门机进行的改动或修改也将使保修失效。

不遵守说明：未能遵守安装说明，包括但不限于不正确的安装、维护将使保修失效。

第三方配件：TOPENS不承担因第三方配件造成的损坏，除非TOPENS客户支持明确推荐的配件。使用兼容配件以确保兼容性并防止门机损坏非常重要。

联系TOPENS支持：请确保门机按照安装手册中概述的指南进行安装、操作和维护，以避免保修失效。如果您对正确使用或需要兼容配件的帮助有任何疑问，请联系TOPENS客户支持寻求指导。

详细保修政策：如果您对TOPENS保修范围有任何疑问，请参阅网址www.topens.com/pages/topens-limited-warranty上的政策。
content_en:
Important Safety Information

OBSTRUCTION PROTECTION TESTING: Test the gate opener monthly. The gate must reverse or stop on contact with a rigid object or when an object activates the non-contact sensors. After adjusting the force or limit travel, retest the gate opener. Failure to adjust and retest the gate opener properly can increase the risk of injury or death.

POWER DISCONNECTION AND MANUAL OPENING: Understand how to disconnect the power and manually open the gate. Disconnect the gate opener from the gate only when the gate is not in motion and the gate opener system is turned off.

RECOGNIZE POTENTIAL RISKS IN AUTOMATED GATE SYSTEMS: Save the installation manual. Make sure everyone who is using or will be around the gate and gate opener are aware of the dangers of automated gate systems. If a replacement manual is needed, you can download a copy from the TOPENS website (www.topens.com).

Note For Warranty

WARRANTY LIMITED TO TARGET MARKET: The warranty is limited to the target market (Contiguous United States, Canada, UK, and Germany). Customers using the product outside these regions will be responsible for any additional expenses during the warranty replacement process.

GATE OPENER ABUSE: TOPENS does not cover damage resulting from abuse, such as attempting to operate the gate opener beyond its specified capacity or using it for unintended purposes.

GATE OPENER MISUSE: TOPENS does not cover damage resulting from misuse, including but not limited to operating the gate opener with incompatible power sources or using it in environments not recommended by TOPENS.

ALTERATIONS OR MODIFICATIONS: Alterations or modifications made to the gate opener without prior consultation with TOPENS will also invalidate warranty coverage.

NON-COMPLIANCE WITH INSTRUCTIONS: Failure to follow the installation instructions, including but not limited to improper installation, maintenance will void the warranty.

THIRD PARTY ACCESSORIES: TOPENS does not cover damage caused by third party accessories, except those specifically recommended by TOPENS Customer Support. It is important to use only compatible accessories to ensure compatibility and prevent damage to the gate opener.

CONTACT TOPENS SUPPORT: Please ensure that the gate opener is installed, operated, and maintained in accordance with the guidelines outlined in the installation manual to avoid voiding the warranty. If you have any questions regarding proper usage or need assistance with compatible accessories, please contact TOPENS Customer Support for guidance.

DETAILED WARRANTY POLICY: If you have any questions regarding what is covered by the TOPENS warranty, refer to the policy at www.topens.com/pages/topens-limited-warranty.

embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Connection of Accessories 1 TKP3 Wireless Keypad - Programming and Operation Title:TKP3 Wireless Keypad - Programming and Operation TKP3 无线密码键盘编程与操作，CODE SW 按钮，OK 按钮，默认密码 888888 **TKP3 无线密码键盘** 使用用户自定义密码操作门 **编程和操作** * 按下并释放控制板上的 CODE SW 按钮。CODE LED 将亮起，表示开门机现在处于编程模式。 * 按下密码键盘上的“OK”按钮，CODE LED 将闪烁 3 秒钟，然后熄灭，表示编程成功。 * 使用 **TKP3 Wireless Keypad** Operate the gate with a user defined password **Programming and Operation** * Press and release the CODE SW button on the
content_zh:
**TKP3 无线密码键盘**
使用用户自定义密码操作门

**编程和操作**
*   按下并释放控制板上的 CODE SW 按钮。CODE LED 将亮起，表示开门机现在处于编程模式。
*   按下密码键盘上的“OK”按钮，CODE LED 将闪烁 3 秒钟，然后熄灭，表示编程成功。
*   使用默认密码“888888”操作开门机。按下“PIN”“888888”，然后按下“OK”按钮操作开门机。只需按下一次“OK”按钮，正在移动的门将停止以便快速通过。

**TKP3 Wireless Keypad**
Operate the gate with a user defined password

**Programming and Operation**
*   Press and release the CODE SW button on the control board. The CODE LED will turn on, indicating that the gate opener is now in programming mode.
*   Press the button "OK" on the keypad and the CODE LED will flash for 3 seconds and then turn off, indicating successful programming.
*   Use the default password "888888" to operate the gate opener. Press "PIN" "888888" and then press the button "OK" to operate the opener. Just one press of the button "OK", the moving gate will stop for quick passing through.

section: Connection of Accessories · Key Installation Notes
question: Key Installation Notes
embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Connection of Accessories Key Installation Notes Title:Key Installation Notes Connection of Accessories Key Installation Notes ET24 Electric Gate Lock pull to open push to open installation lock receiver alignment ◆ 对于向外开启的门，将锁安装在门扇上，接收器安装在墙壁或门柱上。 ◆ 对于向内开启的门，将锁安装在墙壁或门柱上，接收器安装在门扇上。 ◆ 锁和接收器必须紧密配合。当门完全关闭时检查其配合度。 ◆ 确保锁和接收器水平，与开门机臂对齐，并安装在管状围栏或其他门表面坚固的部分。 ◆ For pull to open gate, install the lock on the gate and the receiver on the wall or gate post. ◆ For push to open gate, install the lock on the wall
content_zh:
◆ 对于向外开启的门，将锁安装在门扇上，接收器安装在墙壁或门柱上。
◆ 对于向内开启的门，将锁安装在墙壁或门柱上，接收器安装在门扇上。
◆ 锁和接收器必须紧密配合。当门完全关闭时检查其配合度。
◆ 确保锁和接收器水平，与开门机臂对齐，并安装在管状围栏或其他门表面坚固的部分。
content_en:
◆ For pull to open gate, install the lock on the gate and the receiver on the wall or gate post.
◆ For push to open gate, install the lock on the wall or gate post, and the receiver on the gate.
◆ The lock and receiver must fit close. Check it when the gates close firmly.

content_zh:
TEW3 车辆感应出口地感线圈
当感应到有车辆靠近时，自动打开门。
接线连接
◆ 将黑色线连接到控制板端子 ⑤ “COM”。
◆ 将蓝色线连接到控制板端子 ⑥ “OPSW”。
◆ 将红色线连接到控制板端子 ⑪ “BAT+”。
◆ 将绿色线连接到控制板端子 ⑫ “BAT-”

TEW3 Vehicle Sensor Exit Wand
Opens the gate automatically when senses an approaching car
Wire Connection

◆ Connect the RED wire to the control board terminal ⑪ "BAT+".
◆ Connect the GREEN wire to the control board terminal ⑫ “BAT-”
◆ The sensitivity range adjustment board should be wired to the GREEN wire and the YELLOW wire of the wand, regardless of the polarity of the wires.

content_zh:
主要安装注意事项
◆ 将地感线圈安装在距离门 7.5米至 30米（25英尺至 100英尺）处，埋入地下 5厘米（2英寸）深，并距离车道边缘 20厘米（8英寸）。
◆ 将地感线圈安装在远离任何电源线的位置，以避免干扰检测信号。
◆ 强烈建议参考本手册中控制板设置部分，启用自动关门功能，以确保家庭安全。
content_en:
Key Installation Notes
◆ Install the wand 7.5m to 30m (25ft. to 100ft.) away from the gate, and bury it 5cm (2") deep from ground and 20cm (8") from the driveway edge.
◆ Install the wand away from any power lines to avoid interrupting the detection signal.
◆ It is strongly recommended to enable the auto close function by referring to the Setting of the Control Board section in this manual to ensure home security.

• 将光电传感器安装在离地面至少 20 厘米 (8 英寸) 的位置。
• 将接收器放置在开门机控制盒一侧，直接面对发射器。
• 确保发射器和接收器相互对齐。如果手动精确对齐困难，请使用可见激光束辅助。
• 最大感应范围为 20 米 (65 英尺)，发射器和接收器之间的推荐距离为 3 米至 14 米 (10 英尺至 46 英尺)。

content_en:
Key Installation Notes
• Mount the photocell sensor at least 20cm (8") above the ground.
• Place the receiver on the control box side of the gate opener, directly facing the emitter.
• Ensure that both the emitter and receiver are aligned with each other. If manual precise alignment is difficult, use a visible laser beam for assistance.
• The maximum sensing range is 20m (65ft.), and the recommended distance between the emitter and receiver is 3m to 14m (10ft. to 46ft.).
• Put the cables into PVC conduit and bury the conduit underground to prevent damage.

question: ERM12 External Receiver
embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Connection of Accessories 1 ERM12 External Receiver Title:ERM12 External Receiver Connection of Accessories: ERM12 External Receiver. Wire Connection: BROWN wire to O/S/C terminal 4, BLACK wire to COM terminal 5, RED wire to BAT+ terminal 11. Program Remote Control: Learn Button, M12 remote control. Note on solar power and battery capacity. Allows up to 250 remotes to be programmed with the gate opener. Wire Connection Connect the BROWN wire to the control board terminal ④ "O/S/C". Conne
content_en:
Allows up to 250 remotes to be programmed with the gate opener.

Wire Connection
Connect the BROWN wire to the control board terminal ④ "O/S/C".
Connect the BLACK wire to the control board terminal ⑤ "COM".
Connect the RED wire to the control board terminal ⑪ “BAT+".

Program the Remote Control with the Receiver
Before programming, ensure the M12 remote control is removed from the control board to avoid conflicts.
Press and release the Learn Button on the receiver, the LED light will turn ON. Press the remote control button you want to program once, then press it again after the LED on the remote turns off.
The LED Light on the receiver will flash for 3 seconds and then turn OFF indicating successfully programming.

NOTE: If the gate opener is ONLY solar powered, please add more solar panels and upgrade the battery capacity to support the additional power consumption by the receiver.

content_en:
Open/close gate by pressing wired button.

Wire Connection
Connect the push button to the control board terminal ④ "O/S/C" and terminal ⑤ "COM”, regardless of the polarity of the wires.
Each press of the button will cycle the gate through open, stop, close, stop, and open.

content_zh:
检查门：检查门和铰链是否有任何损坏、生锈或磨损迹象。
检查开门机臂：检查开门机臂是否牢固地连接到门和立柱支架。拧紧任何松动的螺栓和螺钉。
检查电缆和电线：确保所有电缆和电线完好无损，没有任何割伤或磨损。
电池维护：定期检查电池是否漏液，并确保其外壳完好无损。通过控制板监控电池电压。每2-3年更换电池，并妥善回收旧电池。
content_en:
Inspect the Gate: Check for any signs of damage, rust, or wear on the gate and hinges.
Check Gate Opener Arm: Check that the arm is securely attached to both the gate and post brackets. Tighten any loose bolts and screws.
Examine Cables and Wires: Ensure that all cables and wires are intact, without any cuts or frays.
Battery Maintenance: Regularly check for battery leakage and ensure that its casing is intact. Monitor the battery voltage through the control board. Replace the battery every 2-3 years and recycle old batteries properly.

In cold climates where temperatures dr
content_zh:
使用干净的干布擦拭开门机轴，然后喷洒硅酮喷雾以减少摩擦。
在温度降至1°C（30°F）或以下的寒冷气候中，每4-6周对开门机臂喷洒硅酮喷雾以防止结冰。确保硅酮喷雾的冰点低于当地最低温度。
content_en:
Using a clean, dry cloth to wipe the gate opener shaft, and then apply a silicone spray to reduce its friction.
In cold climates where temperatures drop to 1° C (30° F) or below, apply silicone spray to the gate opener arm every 4-6 weeks to prevent freezing. Ensure the silicone freezing point is lower than the lowest local temperature.

embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Gate Opener Status Trouble Shooting Gate automatically opens, but does not automatically close - Check DIP Switch Setting Title:Gate automatically opens, but does not automatically close - Check DIP Switch Setting Gate Opener Status Trouble Shooting - Gate automatically opens, but does not automatically close - Check DIP Switch Setting - DIP switch #1 症状：门机自动打开，但不会自动关闭。可能解决方案：检查DIP开关设置：DIP开关#1的设置可能不正确。控制板上的DIP开关#1用于选择门机的操作模式（推/拉打开）。如果门向物业内部打开（拉开），将DIP开关设置为OFF（出厂默认设置）。如果门向物业外部打开（推开），将DIP开关设置为ON。 Symptom: Gate automatically opens, but does not automatically close. Possible Solution(s): Check DIP Switch Setting: The setting of DIP switch #1 may
content_zh: 症状：门机自动打开，但不会自动关闭。可能解决方案：检查DIP开关设置：DIP开关#1的设置可能不正确。控制板上的DIP开关#1用于选择门机的操作模式（推/拉打开）。如果门向物业内部打开（拉开），将DIP开关设置为OFF（出厂默认设置）。如果门向物业外部打开（推开），将DIP开关设置为ON。
content_en: Symptom: Gate automatically opens, but does not automatically close. Possible Solution(s): Check DIP Switch Setting: The setting of DIP switch #1 may be incorrect. DIP Switch #1 on the control board is used to select the gate's operation mode (push/pull to open). If the gate opens into the property (pull to open), set the DIP Switch to OFF (factory default setting). If the gate opens out from the property (push to open), set the DIP Switch to ON.

Turn off the power to the gate opener, then locate FORCE Potentiometer on the con
content_zh: 调整失速力：失速力设置可能过低。关闭门机电源，然后找到控制板上的FORCE电位器，并将其稍微顺时针旋转以增加失速力。调整后，使用遥控器打开和关闭门，检查问题是否解决。
content_en: Step 1 Adjust Stall Force: The stall force setting might be too low. section: Before You Begin · Check the Gate
question: Check the Gate
embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Before You Begin Check the Gate Title:Check the Gate Before You Begin 安装前准备 工具清单 非端子接线 非控制板端子表 Before You Begin - Check the Gate 确保门扇垂直、水平，并且在铰链上自由摆动，没有卡滞或拖地。门扇应安装在用混凝土固定在地面的非常稳固的立柱或柱子上。安装前，修理或更换所有磨损或损坏的门五金件。
content_zh: 确保门扇垂直、水平，并且在铰链上自由摆动，没有卡滞或拖地。门扇应安装在用混凝土固定在地面的非常稳固的立柱或柱子上。安装前，修理或更换所有磨损或损坏的门五金件。
content_en: Ensure that the gate is plumb, level, and swings freely on its hinges without binding or dragging on the ground. The gate should be mounted to a very stable post or column that is secured in the ground with concrete. Repair or replace all worn or damaged gate hardware prior to installation.

content_en: Tools Needed: Power Drill, Wire Strippers, Level, Phillips Screwdriver, Tape Measure, C-Clamps - small, medium, and large, Hacksaw or Heavy Duty Bolt Cutters, Open End Wrenches - 14# &17# or Adjustable Wrenches.

section: Before You Begin · Items Not Included but May Needed
question: Items Not Included but May Needed
embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Before You Begin Items Not Included but May Needed Title:Items Not Included but May Needed Before You Begin 安装前准备 工具清单 非端子接线 非控制板端子表 Before You Begin - Items Not Included but May Needed: Battery, Solar Panel, PVC Conduit, Connection Cable, Weatherproof Cover, Surge Protector. 不包含但可能需要的物品： 电池和太阳能电池板：如果您选择使用电池和太阳能电池板作为主要电源，您将需要24V 12Ah电池（不包含在内）。支持船用/汽车型电池或铅酸/GEL/AGM/富液（深循环电池）电池，锂离子电池除外。电池应防水，或放置在防水外壳中。A3S/A5S/A8S型号包含两块10W太阳能电池板和一个太阳能充电控制器。如果需要额外的太阳能电池板，TOPENS太阳能电池板套件可单独购买。 P
content_zh:
不包含但可能需要的物品：
电池和太阳能电池板：如果您选择使用电池和太阳能电池板作为主要电源，您将需要24V 12Ah电池（不包含在内）。支持船用/汽车型电池或铅酸/GEL/AGM/富液（深循环电池）电池，锂离子电池除外。电池应防水，或放置在防水外壳中。A3S/A5S/A8S型号包含两块10W太阳能电池板和一个太阳能充电控制器。如果需要额外的太阳能电池板，TOPENS太阳能电池板套件可单独购买。
PVC导管：用于保护连接TC102红外光电传感器到控制板的电缆。
连接线：电源连接和有线附件安装可能需要连接线。请参阅本手册中的“电源连接”和“附件连接”部分以购买正确的电缆。
防风雨罩：如果电源插座位于室外，请使用防风雨罩进行保护。
浪涌保护器：建议将额定电流为5A的浪涌保护器与TS24-U适配器或电源（单独出售）一起使用。
content_en:
Items Not Included but May Needed:
Battery and Solar Panel: If you choose to use batteries and solar panels as main power source, you'll require 24V 12Ah battery (NOT included). Marine / automotive type battery or lead acid / GEL / AGM / flooded (deep cycle battery) batteries are supported, EXCEPT for lithium-ion battery. The batteries should be waterproof, or they should be placed in waterproof housing. Two 10W solar panels and one solar charge controller are included in A3S/A5S/A8S. If additional solar panel is needed, TOPENS solar panel kit is available for separate purchase.
PVC Conduit: Required to protect the cable connecting TC102 infrared photocell sensor to the control board.
Connection Cable: Connection cable may be required for power supply connection and wired accessories installation. Refer to the Connection of Power Supply and Connection of Accessories sections in this manual to purchase the correct cable.
Weatherproof Cover: Use a weatherproof cover to protect the electrical outlet if it is located outdoors.
Surge Protector: A surge protector with a rated current of 5A is recommended to use with the TS24-U adapter or power supply (sold separately).

content_zh: 在多风地区，使用电门锁至关重要，以确保门保持牢固关闭，并防止强风造成的损坏或故障。
content_en: In windy areas, it is crucial to use an electric gate lock to ensure the gate remains securely closed and to prevent damage or malfunction caused by strong winds.

section: Before You Begin · Install Photocell Sensor
question: Install Photocell Sensor
embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Before You Begin Install Photocell Sensor Title:Install Photocell Sensor Before You Begin 安装前准备 工具清单 非端子接线 非控制板端子表 Before You Begin - Install Photocell Sensor 强烈建议在以下情况出于安全考虑安装光电传感器：如果您的物业有儿童或宠物，开门机自动关门功能设置为开启，开门机失速力设置为最大，安装了车辆出口传感器，或使用了其他门控制设备。
content_zh: 强烈建议在以下情况出于安全考虑安装光电传感器：如果您的物业有儿童或宠物，开门机自动关门功能设置为开启，开门机失速力设置为最大，安装了车辆出口传感器，或使用了其他门控制设备。
content_en: It is highly recommended to install a photocell sensor in the following situations for safety: if you have children or pets at your property, the gate opener auto close function is set to ON, the gate opener stall force is set to the maximum, a vehicle exit sensor is installed, or other gate control devices are used.

section: Before You Begin · Additional Hardware to Enhance Post Bracket Stability
question: Additional Hardware to Enhance Post Bracket Stability
embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Before You Begin Additional Hardware to Enhance Post Bracket Stability Title:Additional Hardware to Enhance Post Bracket Stability Before You Begin 安装前准备 工具清单 非端子接线 非控制板端子表 Before You Begin - Additional Hardware to Enhance Post Bracket Stability. Bolts for wooden post, metal plate/washer for stability, expansion bolts for concrete post. Post width under 15cm (6 inches). 确保用于将柱支架连接到木柱的螺栓足够长，能够穿过整个柱子。 在螺栓和木柱之间添加金属板或更大的垫圈，以提高支架的稳定性。 对于混凝土柱，请使用膨胀螺栓牢固地安装支架。 如果柱子的宽度或直径小于15厘米（6英寸），则应使用金属柱或浇筑在水泥中。
content_zh:
确保用于将柱支架连接到木柱的螺栓足够长，能够穿过整个柱子。
在螺栓和木柱之间添加金属板或更大的垫圈，以提高支架的稳定性。
对于混凝土柱，请使用膨胀螺栓牢固地安装支架。
如果柱子的宽度或直径小于15厘米（6英寸），则应使用金属柱或浇筑在水泥中。
content_en:
Ensure that the bolts to attach post bracket to wooden post are long enough to pass through the entire post.
Add metal plate or larger washer between the bolt and the wooden post to improve bracket stability.
For concrete post, use expansion bolts to securely mount the bracket.
If the post’s width or diameter is under 15cm (6"), it should be either metal or set in cement.

question: Determine the Position of the Post Bracket Assembly
embedding_text: Document:A3S A5S A8S Installation Manual Chapter:Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting STEP 2 Determine the Position of the Post Bracket Assembly Title:Determine the Position of the Post Bracket Assembly Pull-to-Open 拉式开门 拉开门 内开 inward opening 非推开门 Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting STEP 2 Determine Position Post Bracket Assembly opening angle table A B dimensions 开门角度 16cm 14cm 110 下表列出了根据尺寸A和B确定的大门最大开启角度。例如，若A为16cm(6.3")、B为14cm(5.5")，则大门最大开启角度为110°。测量A和B的尺寸以确定所需的开门角度，然后标记立柱支架的安装位置中心。拉式开门(Pull-to-Open)安装时，大门处于开启位置，且机械臂活动杆应完全缩回。
content_zh: 下表列出了根据尺寸A和B确定的大门最大开启角度。例如，若A为16cm(6.3")、B为14cm(5.5")，则大门最大开启角度为110°。测量A和B的尺寸以确定所需的开门角度，然后标记立柱支架的安装位置中心。拉式开门(Pull-to-Open)安装时，大门处于开启位置，且机械臂活动杆应完全缩回。
content_en: The table shows the maximum opening angle of the gate based on the dimensions of A and B. For example, if A is 16cm (6.3") and B is 14cm (5.5"), the maximum opening angle of the gate is 110°. Measure the dimension of A and B to determine the desired gate opening angle, then mark the center of the mounting locations for the post bracket accordingly.
